newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firm in technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firm in technical rebound.

text.p: Chilean blue chips rebounded to close higher in a technical rally driven by month-end trade by institutional investors, said dealers.
Chilean financial and stock markets are closed Friday for the All Saints Day holiday.
The market is expected to be relatively stable when it reopens Monday as investors analyse company third quarter earnings which have been weaker than anticipated, they said.
"There will be a lot of analysis as investors will be able to see the detailed figures," said one dealer.
The IPSA index ended up 0.90 percent at 98.63 points.
The general IGPA gained 0.42 percent to 5,385.39 points amid light volume of 10.9 billion pesos.
Poor third quarter earnings dragged the market down sharply Wednesday with blue chips off more than one percent.
Only three large companies -- drug-maker LabChile, fertilizer producer Soquimich and telecoms firm CTC -- reported strong profits with their stocks seen firming next week, said traders.
"Not only did they have good results, but they have strong future prospects," said one trader.
LabChile climbed 3.77 percent to 330 pesos while CTC was up 0.25 percent at 2,441 pesos.
Forestry stocks retreated on poor third quarter earnings and on fears that wood pulp prices are not recovering as fast as expected, said dealers.
Pulp producer Copec shed 0.58 percent to 1,700 pesos with paper maker CMPC falling 0.75 percent at 5,280 pesos.
